name: Fibroblast
failures: Fibrosis — the scar response that outcompetes regeneration across heart, lung, liver, kidney and CNS.

see.note: Activated states identifiable in biopsy; no in vivo readout.

model.note: The gap: nobody can specify a healthy fibroblast set-point, only pathological activation.

reach.note: Ubiquitous and non-specific, which makes selective targeting hard.

edit.note: Two antifibrotics slow lung fibrosis. No therapy reverses established scar in any organ.

verify.note: Fibrosis regression is barely measurable in vivo.

anchors: Nintedanib and pirfenidone slow, never reverse, pulmonary fibrosis
